market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. Morgan Stanley's 7% pullback warning is credible given Fed uncertainty, midterm election dynamics, and consumer stress. Oil drop provides temporary relief but geopolitical flashpoints (Gulf, Pakistan-Afghan) can reignite volatility. Expect choppy, range-bound action with sharp intraday moves. Consumer data will be the key swing factor.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI infrastructure capex, M&A wave, and industrial reshoring support structural growth. However, consumer affordability crisis, European weakness, and debt-funded AI spending create asymmetric downside. Buffett's departure signals a generational shift in market leadership. 6-12 month: expect rotation from broad market to selective, earnings-driven names.
